text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heya-hey, Trainer! Wanna try something
like a
part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The manager of the ramen shop I
work at is
running a survey to improve
customer
satisfaction.
choice_data_list: Something like that?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My manager said the more feedback we
get, the
better, so I got tasked with
bringing you along!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Or so she thinks. The truth is, we
needed a
cover-up to get Ines Fujin to
the ramen shop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's because... her friends and the

convenience store manager are lying in
wait
there, ready to kick off her surprise
party!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but if you already have plans, don't
worry
about it! I was just asking in case
you were free.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heya-hey, Boss! It's your favorite
customer, Ines—
choice_data_list: No, I'd love to go.
No, I'd definitely love to go.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager, Palmer, & Helios
text_block_list.text: Seat for one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, what are you all doing? And
you're in
on it too, Boss?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And you messed up the numbers!
Trainer's here
too, so you should have
said "two—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, when did you get changed,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wha? What's this all about?!
choice_data_list: Please have a seat right here.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I now present to you your first dish. This
highly
nutritious salad was curated in
part by yours truly.
Don't worry, I'll send
you the recipe later.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wow, it looks so cute and
delicious! I think
even my sisters would
eat this...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Next up... We have some sashimi for you. This dish has been approved by one of our veteran part-timers! You're going to love it, Fu.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It looks amazing! And it's low on
fat while
still being filling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And here's your drink delivery... An energizing juice for all your flyer-distributing needs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... the manager said they can't make
it today
'cause of work, but they wanted
you to enjoy this
in-development sports
drink!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The name of this dish is "Running Fam!"
'Cause
we're down to run with you
whenever and
wherever! ☆
choice_data_list: And as for dessert—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Amazing! I have no notes! But...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I am extremely confused right now!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Okay. The truth is, I lied about the
customer
satisfaction survey.
choice_data_list: Well, figures.
Well, that was bound to happen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: R-really?! So what's going on here?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Grati...tude?
choice_data_list: This is the shop managers' way of giving back to you.
This is the shop managers' way of giving back to you.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Fu, thanks for all you do. Your cheerful
attitude
towards work has been such a
boon to this place.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Your cheerfulness and proactive work
ethic have
been a help so many times.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we wanted to repay you
for
everything you've done.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You guys... I should be the one repaying the favor here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But still, I want to make the most of your
kind
gesture!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Time to savor every last crumb of this
goodwill
gourmet course!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Mmf... Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! What a meal! The food was so

delicious—mild and sweet, just how I like
it!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it! So, what did you think? I
hope
you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This one's a no-brainer! A gesture like
this,
arranged by all the people I love...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: As if it could be anything but amazing!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: What a relief!
choice_data_list: Looks like a massive success!
Looks like a massive success, huh!
Sorry for keeping it a secret...!
Sorry for keeping it a secret...!
I feel like I understand how you feel now.
I think I understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was one impressive

surprise—annoyingly so! You really got
me good.
choice_data_list: Looks like a massive success!
Looks like a massive success, huh!
Sorry for keeping it a secret...!
Sorry for keeping it a secret...!
I feel like I understand how you feel now.
I think I understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But surprises really are awesome! I
want to get
another one sometime.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Which means I've got to keep doing my

best—with my races, work, everything! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smiles spread across everyone's faces,
and our
show of gratitude for Ines Fujin
ends up an
enormous success.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not even mad... Wait, did you
want me to
be?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you did fib to me. Okay, as
punishment...
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm signing you all up for a goodwill gesture from me next time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We all join in with the lighthearted
banter, and
our show of gratitude for
Ines Fujin ends up a
success.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The way I feel? What does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Oh, really?
choice_data_list: That happy feeling you get when someone appreciates what you did.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come to understand exactly how Ines
Fujin feels,
and our show of gratitude for
her ends up a
success.
